clusters.title: AI Coding Agents Enhance JVM Development
clusters.summary: The JVM ecosystem is witnessing a significant boost with the introduction of AI coding agents. A recent article by Bruno Borges provides a step-by-step guide on configuring JDK 25 for GitHub Copilot, ensuring seamless integration and compatibility. Meanwhile, JetBrains has announced the beta release of Junie CLI, a standalone AI coding agent that can be used across various environments. The ethics of AI code review is also being discussed, with a JetBrains blog post highlighting its benefits, such as faster checks and better consistency. Although not directly related to JVM, the Computer Science and AI BSc Open Day in Cyprus, supported by the JetBrains Foundation, underscores the growing importance of AI in software development. Overall, the community is embracing AI-driven tools, with Reddit and Twitter discussions focusing on their potential to enhance development efficiency and accuracy. As Kerry Beetge notes, "84% of developers are using code review tools," indicating a significant shift towards AI-assisted development in the JVM ecosystem.

articles.title: How to Configure JDK 25 for GitHub Copilot Coding Agent
articles.summary: This article provides a guide on configuring the GitHub Copilot coding agent to use a specific Java version, such as JDK 25, in an ephemeral GitHub Actions environment. By following these steps, developers can ensure that Copilot can successfully build and test their Java projects with the desired Java version. The post focuses on JDK 25, highlighting its importance for projects that require this specific version.

articles.title: The Ethics of AI Code Review
articles.summary: The article discusses the ethics of AI code review, highlighting its growing application in software development, and its benefits such as faster checks, better consistency, and catching critical security issues. It references the 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, which shows 84% of developers using code review tools, but does not specifically focus on JVM technologies. However, it is published on the JetBrains blog, which is relevant to the JVM ecosystem due to their development of IntelliJ IDEA, a popular IDE for JVM languages like Java, Kotlin, and Scala.

articles.title: Computer Science and AI BSc Open Day in Cyprus
articles.summary: The Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence bachelor's program at Neapolis University Pafos is hosting an Open Day on March 29, supported by the JetBrains Foundation, offering a chance to meet professors, learn about the program, and see the campus, with no specific JVM technologies or versions mentioned in the article.

articles.title: Junie CLI, the LLM-agnostic coding agent, is now in Beta
articles.summary: JetBrains has announced the beta release of Junie CLI, a standalone AI coding agent that can be used from the terminal, inside any IDE, or in CI/CD pipelines, offering a major step forward in the development of Junie, allowing for more flexible and integrated use of the coding agent, regardless of the integrated development environment or continuous integration and continuous deployment setup, with no specific JVM technologies or versions mentioned in the announcement.
